builds.title: Wemic gully guide, racial Hit Dice only
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 8 (5 racial HD, LA +3).
traits: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +2, size −1, and natural armor +4. Touch 11, flat-footed 13. BAB +5, grapple +15. Fortitude +6, Reflex +6, Will +5.
Large size imposes −1 on attacks and AC, −4 to Hide, and grants +4 on grapple checks. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. The player entry specifies twice Medium lifting and carrying limits.
+8 racial bonus on Jump. A 40-ft. land speed adds another +4 under the core Jump rule. Jumping is part of movement. A running jump needs 20 ft. of run-up, or the DC doubles.

Two front claws are natural weapons that deal 1d6 piercing and slashing damage each before Strength. With a one-handed weapon, the player entry allows one secondary claw at −5 on the attack roll and half the Strength bonus to damage.
Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Great Fortitude adds +2 to Fortitude saves.
actions: One claw +10 melee for 1d6+6. On a full attack, two claws at +10 for 1d6+6 each. Critical ×2 on both.
With 20 ft. of run-up, use Jump +26 against DC 20 to cross a 20-ft. gap. The run-up and jump together use 40 ft. of movement.
builds.tactics: Tavaro crosses the gully first to reach the rope anchor. He checks the approach and keeps enough open ground for a running jump.

builds.title: Wemic ford guard, Barbarian 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 4. ECL 9 (5 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +3).
builds.speed: 50 ft. with fast movement; base 40 ft.
traits: Neutral. Leather armor +2, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +2, size −1, and natural armor +4. Touch 11, flat-footed 17. Armor check penalty −2. BAB +6, grapple +17. Fortitude +6, Reflex +6, Will +5.
Large size imposes −1 on attacks and AC, −4 to Hide, and grants +4 on grapple checks. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. The player entry specifies twice Medium lifting and carrying limits.
+8 racial bonus on Jump. A 40-ft. land speed adds another +4 under the core Jump rule. Jumping is part of movement. A running jump needs 20 ft. of run-up, or the DC doubles.

Two front claws are natural weapons that deal 1d6 piercing and slashing damage each before Strength. With a one-handed weapon, the player entry allows one secondary claw at −5 on the attack roll and half the Strength bonus to damage.
Fast Movement raises land speed to 50 ft. and the speed bonus to Jump to +8. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Improved Initiative adds +4. Power Attack and illiteracy.
actions: Large battleaxe +12 melee one-handed for 2d6+7 slashing, critical ×3. Full attack with the axe at +12/+7 plus one secondary claw at +7 for 1d6+3.

Rage 1/day for up to 8 rounds. AC 17, HP 63 at full health, grapple +19, Fortitude +8, Reflex +6, Will +7. Full attack with the battleaxe at +14/+9 for 2d6+9 and one claw at +9 for 1d6+4. When rage ends, lose the 12 HP from increased Constitution and become fatigued for the rest of the encounter.
builds.tactics: Nasha guards the broad approach while the crew crosses. She uses the battleaxe alone while moving and adds the secondary claw when she can make a full attack.

concepts.name: Tavaro Sunmane
concepts.motive: Secure a rope across the gap before the water rises.
concepts.hook: Tavaro points out a flat approach to the far-side anchor.

concepts.name: Nasha Reedstep
concepts.motive: Keep the approach clear until the crew reaches the other bank.
concepts.hook: Nasha waits on the wider bank where there is room to turn.
